rca of the issue: Regression RCA: Sprint 1 added `execution_chain_correlated` as a HIGH-class synthetic node with weight 3.0 that fires whenever the decode chain has >=3 stages. The gating logic does not distinguish between (a) an attack chain (parent->child->grandchild process/network execution) and (b) a benign decoder unwrap chain (Layer 0 -> Layer 1 -> Layer 2 of text normalization). For benign 'hello world' this yields 1 HIGH + 3 LOW, driving verdict to Suspicious @ 60%. Fix path: require the correlated chain to contain at least one non-decode/non-normalize evidence class before it emits a HIGH synthetic, or downgrade the synthetic to MEDIUM when composed entirely of decoder layer nodes. Frontend RCA: The compact mode was intended for a mini header, but LabV2 now mounts the canonical card in the sidebar and still passes compact=true, so timeline is suppressed.
